paraphrase: The official PTX reference describes ex2.approx.f32 and div.full.f32 as approximate operations, with up to two ULP error; div.full is not fully IEEE rounding compliant. These instruction contracts do not determine a unique correct-rounded bit function. Default SM20+ subnormals are supported unless .ftz is present. No .ftz appears in the captured ex2/div sites.
evidence_boundary: Documentation is contextual instruction evidence; no theorem is derived by treating this URL or compiler output as an axiom.
